resources.string: The gateway no longer accepts this app\'s connect key
WhatsApp is not available right now
This link was taken from %1$s. Unlinking here leaves it linked there.
This link was taken from another Rosty app. Unlinking here leaves it linked there.
Use the link from another Rosty app
Already linked on this phone, no key to paste
Your WhatsApp link is kept in a vault on this phone. This passphrase opens it after a restart, or when your fingerprint or face can’t.
Your old passphrase stops working. The next time you unlock, type this one once; after that your fingerprint or face works again.
Write it down or keep it in a password manager. Rosty shows it only once and can’t recover it.
Copied. The clipboard is cleared in 1 minute.
Type groups %1$d and %2$d of your passphrase to check that you saved it.
Unlock with your fingerprint or face.
Your screen lock or fingerprint confirms each try.
Your phone restarted, so the passphrase is needed once.
Three days have passed since the passphrase was last typed, so it’s needed once.
The phone’s clock was set back, so the passphrase is needed once.
Your fingerprints or face changed, so the passphrase is needed once.
Too many failed tries, so the passphrase is needed once.
That passphrase doesn’t open this vault.
A character is wrong or two are swapped. Check the passphrase.
A passphrase has 28 letters and digits, in 7 groups.
Those groups don’t match. Check what you saved.
Set a screen lock (PIN, pattern or password) first: the vault needs it.
Too many attempts. Try again later.
Nobody can recover the passphrase: Rosty never stores it, and it never leaves this phone.
You can reset the vault and link WhatsApp again. Your chats come back from your gateway, and nothing changes on WhatsApp itself.
Resetting deletes the vault, this app’s WhatsApp link and what this app keeps for it. To link again, use another Rosty app that is still linked, paste a connect key, or link a new device.
The vault and this app’s link are deleted. Your chats come back after you link again.

This phone’s security changed (a fingerprint or face was added, or the screen lock was removed), so the key that protects the vault is gone. Reset the vault and link WhatsApp again; your chats come back from your gateway.
Next time, unlock WhatsApp with your fingerprint or face
WhatsApp also locks when the screen turns off. Unlocking takes your fingerprint or face; the passphrase after a restart.
